metadata.technology_reasoning: Man-portable thermal imaging sights are typically handheld or weapon-mounted monocular devices widely used for military, law enforcement, and wildlife observation. The monocular form is the industry standard due to its compact size, weight, and ease of integration with weapons or helmets. Thermal imaging technology in these devices predominantly uses uncooled microbolometer sensors, providing effective infrared detection in a rugged, portable form factor.
